Our Key Features

Quality
investments

We use our deep networks to source the best funds partnering with world class managers globally.

Low
minimums

We offer access to funds for 5k and individual deals from £1.5k with options to pay in installments.

Returns

We have had 2 successful startup exits and are meeting dividend targets in real estate (5-7%).

Tax
benefits

Most startup investments are SEIS/EIS compatible meaning a year 1 rebate of 30-50% and are capital gains/ inheritance tax-free.

Ethics

All our investments are screened for ethics and sharia compliance. 63% of venture deals have minority founders.

Worldwide
access

All investments are available to residents globally (not just limited to UK/US).

Flexibility

Most our funds offer payments in installments and a liquidity pool for early exits if needed.

Community
ethos

Cur8 Captial is an IFG company, the largest investment community for Muslims globally.

All FAQs

  • While most of our deals come from the UK, we invest globally and frequently review projects in North America, South America, East Asia, the Middle East and Africa. 

  • You can invest in:

    1. Real estate 
    2. Start ups (also called venture capital)
    3. Fixed income (also called sukuk or Islamic bonds)

    There are 2 ways to do this: 

    1. Deal by Deal – this is where you choose the individual deal that meet your needs 
    2. Fund – this is a portfolio of investments so you don’t have to do the choosing and get instant diversification.

  • Yes! We have investors from all over the world that are part of the platform. There is no difference in our offering between UK and international investors.

    You may however face some additional onboarding checks as part of our regulatory duties.
